title: Hide temporarily disabled terminals
goal: Use visibility: hidden to hide an element and preserve its position in the typography.
summary: The middle station of the connecting line is under maintenance, and the station name is temporarily displayed. The finish line remains in third position.
tasks: Use visibility to hide the text and background of #middle-stop, retaining the space originally occupied by the middle stop.
Confirm that the starting point and end point are still on the same line, leaving a blank space in the middle.

example.note: The time to be released on the calendar can be hidden first. The page will still leave the original grid for it, and subsequent periods will continue to be aligned.

hint: display: none will remove the element's box from the layout. Use visibility: hidden to leave the site empty.
